n: Sphero Indi Educator Guide and lesson plans
t: A 2021 PDF guide of lessons for the screen-free Sphero indi robot car.
steps: Find the Sphero indi Educator Guide Book PDF.
Read the unit Meet Sphero indi first.
Get indi cars with their color code cards.
Set cards in a sequence for a path.
Start the car on a green card.
Try the Patterns and Sequences lessons.
Look at the INL plan for a K to 5 option.
